title: Restoration Errors: How Often Do Models Silently Fix Their Own Mistakes?

original_idea.body: Auto-detect restoration errors via ground-truth step checking; analyze drivers.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: auto-detectable unfaithfulness + reusable detection harness tells monitors when to distrust clean CoTs.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: generate CoTs, check steps against a simulator; detection logic is intermediate but clear.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused; building the step-checking detector is a contained dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, open models, reusable infra, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + ground-truth checking on math/logic; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Restoration errors defined; driver-analysis and auto-detector at student scale plausibly open.
